Name: Nagito Komaeda NPC - Danganronpa 2
Author: QuoteIzkewl
Description:
[center][size=5][u]﻿﻿Meet Nagito Komaeda, the Ultimate Lucky Student!
[/u][/size]
[size=3]Nagito grew up on the Fern Islands, moving to Pelican Town to finally enjoy some peace and tranquility. He's a polite if awkward and insecure guy, but most importantly of all, superstitious as all heck. Despite it all, he's hopeful that he'll make some new friends. Will you be one of them?[/size]

[size=5][b]Features﻿[/b][/size]
[size=3]🍀Two variants of Nagito to choose from; Canon and Lore! (See further below for more information.)
🍀Seasonal Outfits for both variants!
🍀Marriageable with custom child sprites! (can be disabled in config.)[/size]

[size=5][b]Variants[/b][/size]
[size=3]Nagito comes in two "Variants". Lore is the default option. Dialogue and Visuals can be toggled separately.
[/size][size=4][b]Canon[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GqfDD2S.png[/img]﻿
[/size][size=3]Canon is the Nagito Komaeda Danganronpa fans would already be acquainted with. His dialogue contains a few references to his home series, and he's harsh on himself just as you'd expect. This variant is for if you want your Nagito to be a little unhinged and more "extreme."[/size]
[size=2]Note: Nagito is a character from Super Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, the second game in the Danganronpa franchise. You do not need to have played any of the Danganronpa games to be able to enjoy this mod, but some references will make more sense with the context of the games.[/size]

[size=4][b]Lore[/b]
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/wiI7rK5.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]Lore is more in line with vanilla Stardew Valley, removing most explicit references to Danganronpa to better allow him to fit with the game's standard lore. This variant is for if you want your Nagito to be more grounded in reality.[/size]

[size=5][b]Gift Tastes[/b]
[/size][spoiler][size=4][b]Loves[/b]
[/size]Diamond, Lucky Lunch, Lucky Ring

[size=4][b]Likes[/b]
[/size]Joja Cola, Nautilus Shell, Rainbow Shell, All Flowers, Green Tea, Mango Sapling, Stingray

[size=4][b]Dislikes[/b]
[/size]Honey, Beer, Wine, Pale Ale, Juice, Cookies, Chocolate Cake, Pink Cake, Ice Cream, Blueberry Tart, Sweet Gem Berry

[size=4][b]Hates[/b]
[/size]Skeletal Hand, Rice, Rice Pudding, Fiddlehead Risotto, Stir Fry, Void Essence, Wood, Clay, Limestone, Sandstone, Granite[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]Heart Events[/b]
[/size]Nagito has 5 Canon events and 6 Lore events.

[size=4][b]Canon[/b]
[/size][spoiler]2 Hearts
Enter Nagito's Cottage while he's there.

[b]4 Hearts[/b]
Enter the Museum while Nagito is there.

[b]6 Hearts[/b]
Enter the Spa's bathhouse between 7:00pm and 12:00am.

[b]8 Hearts[/b]
Enter Nagito's Cottage while he's there between 4:00pm and 12:00am after receiving Nagito's letter.

[b]10 Hearts[/b]
Enter the Pelican Town Beach on a sunny day between 8:00pm and 10:00pm.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Lore[/b]
[/size][spoiler][b]2 Hearts[/b]
Enter the Pelican Town Beach on a sunny day when Nagito is there.

[b]4 Hearts[/b]
Enter the Museum while Nagito is there.

[b]5 Hearts[/b]
Enter the Spa's bathhouse between 7:00pm and 12:00am.

[b]6 Hearts[/b]
Enter the Wizard's Tower on a sunny day between 7:00pm and 12:50pm.

[b]8 Hearts[/b]
Enter Nagito's Cottage while he's there between 4:00pm and 12:00am after receiving Nagito's letter.
[b]
10 Hearts[/b]
Enter the Pelican Town Beach on a sunny day between 8:00pm and 10:00pm.[/spoiler]


[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][size=3]
Nagito should work with both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ (Nagito will even show up in the RSV Festivals).
Nagito should be compatible with most mods that edit the beach map, as his cottage only covers up the wood pile near the northern entrance.
[/size][/center]
